title: n8n-MCP cross-tenant access to workflow version backups in multi-tenant HTTP deployments (CVE-2026-54052)
summary: n8n-mcp before 2.56.1 does not isolate its locally stored workflow version history per tenant in multi-tenant HTTP deployments (ENABLE_MULTI_TENANT=true): an authenticated tenant can read workflow version snapshots belonging to other tenants — including full node definitions with credential references and authorization headers — and can delete other tenants' stored backups. stdio and single-tenant HTTP deployments are not affected. Fixed in 2.56.1, which isolates stored history per instance and clears previously un-scoped backups.
